Name: Quick Responses
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod lets you select the first response in two-response questions by pressing a configurable key ("E" by default).

It also lets you select any response in a question by pressing the numer key corresponding to its rank in the list, and show numbers beside the responses to guide you.

You can turn off the numbers or change their colour in the config.json file (created when you first run).


Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], does not use Harmony.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url]

If you want to complain or ask for help or help me test my mods, you can visit [url=https://discord.gg/bs6zHuj]my Discord server﻿[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
